npc.mimicry.bram.new_map: Lost the map? Hah. Here, I drew you another.
npc.mimicry.bram.accepted: Here, the map and my almanac. Mind the chests. And the knights. Mostly the chests.
npc.mimicry.bram.thanks: Three sigils... so they can be laid to rest. This shield was my grandfather's. It's yours now.
dialog.mimicry.bram.title: Bram the Blacksmith
dialog.mimicry.bram.intro:
Ah, a traveler! Mind the anvil, it's hot.

You've the look of someone who opens chests they shouldn't. I respect that. It's how my grandfather lost two fingers.
dialog.mimicry.bram.lore.1: He forged greatswords for the knights of Hollowmere, a keep the old kings built in a cavern under the hills. They lit it with sunstone so their gardens would grow without the sun.
dialog.mimicry.bram.lore.2: The kingdom fell. The knights didn't. They swore to guard the keep until the king came home, and they're still down there, moss to the eyebrows, swinging his swords at anyone who wanders in.
dialog.mimicry.bram.reminder: Bring me three of their sigils and I'll know they can finally rest. The map will lead you to the old mine.
dialog.mimicry.bram.waiting: Three Knight's Sigils. The knights are slow, but they hit like a falling anvil. Step back when they raise the blade.
dialog.mimicry.bram.sigils: Those are their sigils... You actually did it.
dialog.mimicry.bram.friend: The keep's quieter, thanks to you. Come by if you need a blade mended, or a chest looked at.

almanac.mimicry.story.title: The Hungry Chest
almanac.mimicry.story:
For a hundred years the kings fed their coffers gold. When Hollowmere fell, the coffers went hungry, then hunting.
Their children wait in ruins still, patient as oak. Yet a mimic never forgets gold. Offer some, and it may follow you home.
almanac.mimicry.contents.title: Contents
almanac.mimicry.chests.title: Chests That Bite
almanac.mimicry.chests.1:
Any unopened loot chest may be a *mimic*, about one in ten. Beside the real chests of dungeons, temples and fortresses there is often an *extra chest*, and nine in ten of those have teeth.
Open one, or swing at it, and it springs.
almanac.mimicry.chests.2:
*Playing dead,* a mimic sits still as a chest and casts no shadow. Step close and it wakes.
Slay or tame it to win back the loot it swallowed. Slain, it leaves *Mimic Teeth*.
almanac.mimicry.lens.title: The Treasure Lens
almanac.mimicry.lens.1: Gold, a glass pane and a mimic's tooth make a *Treasure Lens*. Hold it in either hand to mark every unopened loot chest within 24 blocks.
almanac.mimicry.lens.2:
*Golden sparks* mean honest treasure.
*Angry puffs* mean teeth.
It marks mimics playing dead out in the open, too.
A smith's advice: look twice, open once.
almanac.mimicry.taming.title: Taming
almanac.mimicry.taming.1: Strange but true: a mimic loves gold above all else. Feed it gold *while it is trying to eat you*. Each treat has a one in three chance to win it over.
almanac.mimicry.taming.2: Its eyes still glow, but now they glow for you. A tame mimic pants with its tongue out, and the tongue tells its health: level when it is well, hanging lower the more it is hurt.
almanac.mimicry.luggage.title: The Luggage
almanac.mimicry.luggage.1:
A tame mimic hops after you and bites whatever attacks you.
*Right-click* it to open its 27 slots. It holds still while you rummage.
*Sneak and right-click* to sit or stand it. Sitting, it shuts its lid and passes for a chest.
almanac.mimicry.luggage.2:
It gulps down drops within six blocks, now and then with a burp, but leaves alone what its owner threw away.
Feed it gold to mend it. If it dies, it spills all it carried.
almanac.mimicry.mimic_chest.title: The Mimic Chest
almanac.mimicry.mimic_chest.1: A chest, two Mimic Teeth and a block of gold to bait it make a *Mimic Chest*. It places like any chest, and it is always a mimic. Good for traps, pranks and nosy neighbours.
almanac.mimicry.coffer.title: The King's Coffer
almanac.mimicry.coffer.1:
They say the king's own coffer grew fat on a kingdom's offerings. It waits before his throne still, guarding the *Crown of Hollowmere*.
It is bigger than a chest has any right to be. Bring friends.
almanac.mimicry.hollowmere.title: Hollowmere
almanac.mimicry.hollowmere.1:
Beneath the hills lies the keep of Hollowmere, built in a cavern the kings lit with *sunstone* so their gardens would grow without the sun.
The keep fell. The gardens did not.
almanac.mimicry.hollowmere.2:
The way in is an old mine, closed by the king's order; my map leads there. Its stair comes out high on the cavern wall, over a meadow, a moat and a ruined castle.
Half the chests in that castle bite.
almanac.mimicry.knights.title: The Moss Knights
almanac.mimicry.knights.1:
The knights swore to guard the keep until the king came home. He never did. They guard it still: slow, heavy, patient.
When a knight *raises its greatsword*, step back. The blow falls hard and wide, and it is slow to recover.
almanac.mimicry.knights.2: Each knight carries a *Knight's Sigil*. Bring three to me at the forge, so I know they can rest. My grandfather's shield is yours for the trouble.
almanac.mimicry.sunstone.title: Sunstone
almanac.mimicry.sunstone.1:
Sunstone clusters hang from the cavern roof and burn like a captured noon. Break one for *shards*.
Set a shard in iron nuggets for a *Sunstone Lantern* to keep the dark off your garden.
almanac.mimicry.sunstone.2: Four iron chains and a shard make four *Sunstone Chains* to hang it from.
almanac.mimicry.chimneys.title: Chimneys
almanac.mimicry.chimneys.1: Wall a campfire in with bricks or stone bricks for a *chimney*. It smokes like the campfire inside, and over a hay bale it sends up a tall signal column, like my forge's.
npc.mimicry.bram.out_cold: Bram is out cold. He'll be back on his feet in a minute.
